10+ Years of Dedication
Meet the Instructor

Mrs. Soma Dutta

Mrs. Soma Dutta is the founder and head instructor of Atmik Yoga and Fitness Center — a space born from her lifelong devotion to the art and science of yoga, wellness, and movement. Her journey is as inspiring as the classes she leads.

A highly qualified fitness professional, she brings rare depth to every session — balancing ancient yogic wisdom with modern Zumba energy in a calm, nurturing environment beside nature.

🎓
Double Master's Degree Holder — Academic excellence that informs her teaching philosophy
📜
Yoga from Bardhaman University — Certified and deeply trained in classical yoga traditions
🌿
Pursuing Masters from Sri Sri University — Continuing her pursuit of knowledge at one of India's leading wellness institutions
🏆
Multi-Award Winning Center — Students and performances celebrated across regional competitions
🌐
Online & Offline Classes — Join from the comfort of your home or visit us in person
What We Offer

Classes for Every Body

Whether you are a complete beginner or a seasoned practitioner, our programs are designed to meet you exactly where you are. First-timers receive a free demo class — online or offline.

🧘‍♀️

Yoga

Classical asana practice, pranayama, and meditation — from foundational to advanced levels. Suitable for all ages and body types. Build flexibility, strength, and inner stillness.

💃

Zumba

High-energy dance-fitness sessions set to vibrant music. Burn calories, boost mood, and move joyfully. Perfect for those who want fitness to feel like a celebration.

🌿

Wellness

Holistic wellness sessions combining breathwork, relaxation techniques, and mindfulness practices. Reduce stress, sleep better, and cultivate lasting well-being.

👴

Senior Yoga

Gentle, chair-assisted yoga designed for senior practitioners. Safe, slow, and deeply beneficial — improving mobility, balance, and quality of life at any age.

👦

Kids Yoga

Fun, engaging yoga sessions for children. Builds focus, coordination, and confidence while making fitness a lifelong positive habit from an early age.

🖥️

Online Classes

Can't make it in person? Join us live from anywhere in the world. Full access to all programs, personalized attention, and the same warm energy — virtually.

Questions Answered

Frequently Asked Questions

Not at all! Our classes are designed for all levels — from absolute beginners to advanced practitioners. Mrs. Soma Dutta personally assesses each student and ensures the practice is suitable for your current fitness level and health condition.
Yes! Every new student is entitled to a complimentary demo class — available both online and offline. This gives you a chance to experience our teaching style, the center ambiance, and decide if it's the right fit for you — all without any commitment.
All our programs — Yoga, Zumba, Wellness, Kids Yoga, and Senior Yoga — are available both online and offline. Online students receive the same personalized attention and can join live sessions from anywhere in the world.
Our current schedule is: Evening classes at the main center on Monday, Wednesday & Friday — 5:30–6:30 PM & 7:00–8:00 PM. Morning classes at the main center Tuesday to Friday 7:00–8:00 AM, and Saturday & Sunday 7:30–8:30 AM. Online classes are held Wednesday & Thursday 7:00–8:00 AM, and Saturday 7:30–8:30 AM. Contact us to confirm availability and book your slot.
Absolutely. We have dedicated programs for both senior practitioners (gentle, chair-assisted yoga) and children (fun, engaging kids yoga). Mrs. Soma Dutta is experienced in adapting practices to all age groups and physical abilities.
Comfortable, stretchable clothing is all you need. We provide yoga mats at the center. If joining online, a quiet space and a yoga mat at home is sufficient. Stay hydrated — bring a water bottle — and try to avoid heavy meals 2 hours before class.
Atmik Yoga and Fitness Center is located in Asansol, West Bengal. What makes it truly special is its setting — adjacent to a lush green park, morning classes are held in a naturally serene, fresh-air environment that makes meditation and yoga practice deeply rejuvenating. It's not just a gym — it's a sanctuary.
We offer flexible monthly, quarterly, and annual membership plans to suit different needs and budgets. Please contact Mrs. Soma Dutta directly at +91 79087 64229 or soma.asn1984@gmail.com for the most current fee details and any ongoing offers.
Privacy

Privacy Note

Information submitted through the demo form is used to respond to your class enquiry. The form asks for basic contact and scheduling information. Do not enter unnecessary sensitive medical information.

Terms

Booking Terms

A demo date/time submitted through this website is a preference request until the centre confirms the batch. Class timings and availability may change.

Wellness

Health Disclaimer

Yoga and fitness sessions are educational and wellness activities and are not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment. Anyone with an injury, medical condition, pregnancy, or other health concern should seek appropriate professional guidance before exercising.
